T4 separately identifies the boundary and enthusiasm changes under “Search preference changed” and the unchanged commercial facts under “Evidence did not change.” It preserves both the task-manager route and its strongest clean-slate rival, then ends with a matched, bounded commercial investigation using comparable time and cash caps, concrete recurring offers, and behavioral measures without forcing a final choice.
